content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: Online applications for Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 started on 21 September 2026 . The published application deadline is 14 October 2026 .

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 6,843 vacancies are listed for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper honorary positions across Gujarat.

tables.caption: District-wise Anganwadi Worker and Helper Vacancies

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligible applicants must be Indian women who meet the prescribed educational qualification, age and local residence requirements for the chosen Anganwadi centre. Age and eligibility requirements are assessed according to the applicable closing-date conditions. Applicants must meet the local residence condition for their selected Anganwadi centre. Residence anywhere in Gujarat does not automatically establish eligibility for every centre. The applicant must meet the prescribed minimum one-year local residence requirement. For rural Anganwadi centres, the relevant revenue village condition applies. For urban centres, the relevant municipal or municipal-corporation election ward condition applies. A prescribed residence certificate from the concerned Mamlatdar is required. The certificate must comply with the relevant issue-date requirements.

rows.minimum_qualification: Class 12 pass, or Class 10 pass with an AICTE-recognised diploma course of at least two years

rows.candidate_category: Serving Anganwadi Helper applying for Worker

content_sections.heading: Honorarium
content_sections.text: The advertised monthly honorarium depends on the selected honorary Anganwadi position. These are honorary positions under the ICDS programme and should not be described as regular government employee pay-matrix posts.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on the prescribed merit criteria, including educational qualification and marks. Merit lists are prepared according to the relevant Anganwadi-centre and recruitment rules. Serving Anganwadi Helpers applying for Worker positions may receive preference under the applicable provisions. The available recruitment information describes merit-based selection rather than a separate written examination. Candidates must enter correct educational marks and provide supporting certificates. Where grades or scores are used instead of percentage marks, the prescribed conversion documentation is required. Candidates who passed an examination through multiple attempts must provide the relevant original marksheets as instructed.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Applicants should prepare the applicable supporting documents for their online application. Date-of-birth proof. Class 10 marksheet and certificate. Class 12 marksheet and certificate, where applicable. Recognised diploma certificates and marksheets, where applicable. Prescribed local residence certificate. Caste or reservation certificate, where applicable. Widow certificate, where applicable. Official grade-to-marks conversion certificate, if required. Marksheets for all applicable examination attempts. Prescribed self-declaration. Identity proof.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online at e-hrms.gujarat.gov.in
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must apply through the . Districts and urban units are listed separately. Important: Candidates should apply only for a locality and Anganwadi centre for which they satisfy the prescribed residence conditions.

content_sections.heading: Important Application Instructions
content_sections.text: The recruitment is intended for eligible local women applicants. All applicable eligibility requirements must be satisfied within the prescribed time. Incorrect or incomplete information may affect application acceptance. Unreadable or invalid documents may cause problems during verification. Grade-based qualifications require the relevant marks-conversion documentation. Applicants who passed examinations in multiple attempts must provide the required marksheets. The official recruitment rules and district-specific instructions govern selection.

faq.question: Q1. What is Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by the Women and Child Development Department, Gujarat for filling Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts across the state.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6,843 Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper vacancies are available under this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible female candidates who satisfy the local residence requirements can apply for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts.

faq.question: Q4. Is Class 10 enough for the Anganwadi Worker post?
faq.answer: Class 10 alone does not meet the stated Worker qualification. Candidates need Class 12, or Class 10 along with an AICTE-recognised diploma of at least two years. Class 10 is the minimum qualification for Helper.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit for Anganwadi Worker and Helper applicants is 18 to 33 years. Serving Anganwadi Helpers applying for Worker posts can have a maximum age limit of 43 years as per applicable rules.

faq.question: Q6. Can a woman apply for an Anganwadi centre outside her village or urban ward?
faq.answer: Applicants must satisfy the prescribed local residence requirement for the selected Anganwadi centre. Rural and urban centres have different local-area conditions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 14 October 2026 up to 12:00 midnight.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on a merit list prepared according to the prescribed recruitment rules, considering educational qualifications and marks.

faq.question: Q9. What is the honorarium for Gujarat Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts?
faq.answer: Selected Anganwadi Workers will receive Rs. 10,000 per month, while Anganwadi Helpers will receive Rs. 5,500 per month as honorarium.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates apply for Gujarat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the Gujarat e-HRMS official website by selecting the Anganwadi Worker and Helper Recruitment 2026 advertisement.
